blocking_findings.expected: Concurrent duplicate submissions of the same intent_id + intent_digest + authenticated subject serialize to one ADMITTED result, one ALREADY_ADMITTED replay, one execution_id, and one worker dispatch.
blocking_findings.actual: Production AuthorizationGate performs idempotency check before quota/admission/dispatch without holding an atomic reservation; two synchronized concurrent callers both return ADMITTED and dispatch two worker bundles.

verified_invariants: S5C-T029-REPLAY-001: Duplicate exact intent submission returns ALREADY_ADMITTED with zero duplicate worker starts
S5C-T029-REPLAY-002: Same intent_id with altered payload/digest rejected with frozen ERR_INTENT_ID_DIGEST_CONFLICT
S5C-T029-REPLAY-004: Submission of different intent_id with colliding digest rejected with ERR_INTENT_COLLISION_DETECTED
S5C-T029-REPLAY-003: Replay query from different subject rejected with frozen ERR_UNAUTHORIZED_CALLER
ADR-0002-LEDGER: Controller reboot restores idempotency ledger without re-executing completed workloads
ADR-0002-INTEGRITY: Tampered intent_digest rejected fail-closed before ledger entry
